data.name: Gelatin
data.description:
{Introduction}: Gelatin is a cool dude, and it's not because you have to put gelatin in the fridge. He's a goofball who does things just because he thinks they are amusing. He doesn't seem to have a conscience, although he doesn't have a desire to do bad things, either. For example, he enjoys throwing forks and doesn't care where they land! Still, when others ask him for help, Gelatin always finds a way.Random fact: Gelatin is claustrophobic. He doesn't like tight places.
{Appearance}: Gelatin appears to be lime-flavored gelatin. His main body is jade, and his bottom lighting is spring green.
{Personality}: In BFDIA, Gelatin has a very laid back personality as he is calmer than most contestants when handling situations. He is presumed to have made the freeze juice and the anti-poison, which indicates that he is well-read (pun intended) on chemistry. His concern for others varies, as while he saved Match from being squashed by the HPRC in "Zeeky Boogy Doog", in "Get Digging" and "Get in the Van" he threw his own teammates off Puffball because of his claustrophobia (he later did this in "Don't Dig Straight Down", and was about to in "The Four is Lava", but got himself pushed off instead).
In BFB, he retains his laid back personality, but he's more reckless and inconsiderate than he was in BFDIA, supported by the fact that he kept throwing forks at Death P.A.C.T. (although he stopped doing that since BFB 4) and suggesting to kill Bomby to his team's advantage.
He's also a bit more impulsive, especially around Donut. He doesn't think twice about doing something unless he is told not to. An example of this is, once again, him repeatedly trying to use Bomby's explosive properties to win until being told otherwise, despite the fact that this would result in the latter's death. In "The Escape From Four", when he did not get a speck of dust, he started crying. He is also shown to be a bit petty.
In some of the later post-split BFB episodes, he definitely acts a lot more childish, like in "B.F.B. = Back From Beginning", he tries to eat the blue dirt, further proving that he doesn't think twice about most things. He also said in "Uprooting Everything" that the reason he wanted to transfer Lollipop's purple color to himself was only because "it looked cool", not to honor Lollipop or anything.
However, in "Chapter Complete", Gelatin starts acting more mature. He gets mad at Four, explaining how much hurt Four inflicted on the contestants, but at the same time, showing how much everyone loves him.
{Abilities}: -Poison immunity: In "Zeeky Boogy Doog", Flower threw a bug on Gelatin that didn't trigger the poison effect on him as he's immune to bug poison.
-Disguise: Any disguise with Gelatin as a component seems to be very good at fooling other people. For example, Match, Bubble, and the Announcer were each able to convincingly disguise themselves as a tree using Gelatin, and Gelatin himself, when disguised as Flower managed to fool all of the Have Nots except for Flower herself. He can also disguise himself by changing shape and general appearance, like as how he impersonates Loser in "Take the Tower".
-Sharp-shooting: In “Catch These Hands”, Gelatin managed to shoot the letters and lever from Goiky to Yoyleland where the HPRC is located and is located 2763 miles away so Gelatin had very far eyesight.
{Weaknesses}: -Solubility: In multiple episodes, when liquid (mostly water) is poured on Gelatin, he becomes soggy and weak.
{Relationship}: In "X Marks the Spot", Gelatin notices that Teardrop was left behind with Two, so he shouts to go back and retrieve her.
In "How Loe Can You Grow?", Gelatin asks Teardrop to get Four to show him the crops, and she happily obliges.
In "Let's Raid The Warehouse", Gelatin and Teardrop volunteer to retrieve gifts for Leafy and Lollipop, along with Bubble. The two seem to get along while searching the warehouse.
In "The Game Has Changed", Teardrop apologizes for her behavior towards Gelatin by throwing him a party dedicated to him with things he likes. The two reach an agreement to keep things silly and not use violence, and they make up.
In "The Tweested Temple", Gelatin congratulates Teardrop for surviving the elimination. Gelatin brings Teardrop along so Gelatin, Teardrop, and Lollipop can find the artifacts together, expressing his friendship towards her. She later joins the alliance between Gelatin and Lollipop happily.
In "The Hidden Contestant", Gelatin wishes Teardrop luck as she rises towards the BRB while hanging onto Flower, who is hanging onto Profily.
In "Uprooting Everything", Teardrop and Gelatin have a group hug with Lollipop when she's eliminated. During the challenge, Teardrop drags Gelatin (and Leafy) away from Flower. She claps his hand and Gelatin says he likes working with her. She then claps his and Leafy's hands at the same time. Gelatin catches on to Teardrop suggesting that they should add Leafy to the alliance. Gelatin is more then happy with the idea since it would be easier for them all gang up on Flower so that they can all move on to the next round.
In "B.F.B. = Back From Beginning", they meet up at episode 25's challenge, and go inside the temple to collect their totems. When they're climbing up the ladders in the oven, Gelatin tells Teardrop to knock Flower off her ladder, since they were actual members of the alliance, which ends up failing and causing Flower to win the challenge.
In "SOS (Save Our Show)", Gelatin is sad that the alliance will be coming to an end after Cake at Stake. He tells Teardrop it's been fun working with her and they high five before the results are revealed.
In "Chapter Complete", Teardrop votes for Gelatin to win and Gelatin thanks her. As Gelatin moves through different BFB clips with the BFB, he enthusiastically points out a scene with Teardrop in it to her, not that she cares. When Lollipop is concerned that they haven't seen Four, Gelatin refers to Teardrop as a special, smart friend who's good at helping with stuff like this and asks if she sees anything that could relate to Four. Teardrop pops her head out of the SuperVan to look and successfully points out a tree that Four sank into. When everyone realizes that Four sank into the BRB, Gelatin asks if Teardrop can just walk up it like before and she nods her head that she can. At the end of the episode, Gelatin says that his BFB comic was inspired by Teardrop's comics and asks his audience if they think she'll like it.
In "Who Stole Donut's Diary?", Gelatin notices that Teardrop was not taking notes, but was instead making a comic of herself. In this comic, Teardrop kills Gelatin with radioactive powers, which upsets him.
In "Fashion For Your Face!", the Have Cots take a steam train to Yellow Face's Warehouse. The train goes around a loop, to which Gelatin exclaims that it was so scary that he heard Teardrop scream. She angrily points at him, and he questions why.
In the same episode, Teardrop rips open Gelatin's sweater pod while inside Purple Face, and he burns in his stomach acids, killing him. Though she only did this so Gelatin could win for the team.
In "The Game Has Changed", Gelatin confronts Teardrop about her reckless actions towards him, including killing him in the previous episode. He asks Teardrop to leave him alone for a while, telling her that he feels uncomfortable around her. Teardrop walks away, looking depressed.
